materials.border: charred volcanic rock with cracked cooling lava edges, ember glow in crevices
materials.panels: dark basalt plaques with thin molten-gold inner borders and forged metal corner caps
materials.ornament: flowing flame tongues, sparks, heat haze

side_fill: rich painted flames and molten rivulets filling left and right borders; jagged spiky outer silhouette like cooling lava rock
title_box_style: empty dark basalt horizontal banner with glowing molten inner stroke and metal corner brackets, no text
footer_box_style: matching empty dark banners left and right; sacred flame crest on upward rock peak between them

constraints.notes: Must have a clearly framed central art aperture with visible inner rim/bezel; art interior empty for transparency punch.

prompt_extras: CRITICAL: Include a proper recessed CARD ART WINDOW in the center — a clean rectangular picture-frame aperture with a thick forged-metal / carved-stone inner bezel that clearly frames where card artwork goes. The interior of that window must be EMPTY (pure white or pure magenta), not black fill, not flames, not rock. The bezel must fully surround the art opening on all four sides and sit BETWEEN the top title plaque and the two bottom plaques with clear separation — title above the art bezel, bottom plaques below it. Do not cover the title plaque or bottom plaques with the art hole. Empty plaques only — zero lettering. Premium illustrated TCG frame.
